sourceText:
Blueberry Salad With Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, March 2, 2010 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




1 pound romaine lettuce in bite-size pieces
1 cup fresh blueberries
3 ounces crumbled blue cheese
1/2 cup toasted pecans chopped
1/2 cup salad oil
3 tablespoons white wine vinegar
1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
1 teaspoon sugar

Preparation

1 In a large salad bowl, combine lettuce, blueberries, blue cheese and nuts. In a separate container, mix salad oil, vinegar, mustard and sugar until well blended. Just before serving, toss dressing through salad mixture. 2 Gerri Says: With blueberries in season almost all year round, a change in salad selections is always a welcome treat in our home.
